# Review Round-02 — Functionality (第 1–2291 條)

> 日期:2026-09-18。L1 靜態 review,不實跑(§十八 a/j)。
> 每條輸出:8 問(Q1..Q8)+ 5 段(🎯/📥/▶/📤/🚧)+ §十八 h 三項 + verdict(§二十一 鎖版定義)。
> 四類必抓:e 跑錯位置 / c 應全量卻挑行 / d sensor 無 fallback / b vendor slot 未標。
> 範圍:xlsx `Functionality` sheet row 2–201(前 200 條,對應 2291 全表之首段)。
> 編號約定(收官定版):item = row − 1(Functionality rows 2–2292 → items 1–2291,與 tests.json 之 2291 條一致)。⚠️ 歷史批次「## 第 A–B 條」區段/頂部 def-block 為逐批當下紀錄,曾採 row−2 條號(off-by-one,已於頭/尾標注);逐條清單以 item=row−1 為準,收官時重編為 1–2291。row 202(Wistron-HW-00211 Hot Plugging)過往未派條號,已補為 item 201。
>
> **判定基準(§二十一 鎖版)**:
> - YES = operator 一次性給完輸入後 agent 自跑到底、中途不需人動手/在場/批准;會 reboot 只要備註風險+提前問仍 YES。
> - PARTIAL = 執行中某步要人動手/在場看/批准。
> - NO/PHYSICAL = 要人手動物理操作,agent 只給事後證據包。
> - UNRESOLVED = 8 問任一答不出 / 5 段任一缺 / TBD。
>
> **Q-LIT 規則(沿用 Round-1 已拍板)**:ssh 內層 grep 雙引號 → 改單引號,避免 agent-host 端字串切爆。

## 第 1–200 條 review 統計

**verdict(§二十一 鎖版)分布**:
| verdict | 條數 | 說明 |
|---|---|---|
| NO/PHYSICAL | 108 | 物理/目視(Mechanical、PSU Latch/LED/fault 注入、CPU/LED、Button、Power cycle...) |
| PARTIAL | 76 | 有前置(PMBus、VGA/Resolution 需人眼、RTC/AC、TPM BIOS-side、BMC-LAN set...) |
| YES | 16 | 只讀/自跑(dmidecode/lscpu/ipmitool OOB 讀、Fan speed get...) |

**瑕疵統計(四類必抓 + Q-LIT)**:
| class | 條數 | 對應編號 |
|---|---|---|
| Q-LIT(ssh 內層 grep 雙引號) | 29 | HW-00072/73/74/75、00094、00110、00116、00127/128、00148、00155、00158、00162、00184~00193、00196~00199、00201、00210 |
| §十九 o 假完成(僅列設備名、未讀實際 PMBus register) | 8 | HW-00049~00056 |
| §十八 d(sensor get 未附 fallback) | 0(未命中) | — |
| §十八 c(應全量卻挑行) | 本批讀取題多為全量+粗篩,未見漏抓 | — |
| §十八 b(vendor slot 未標) | PMBus 需 `${PMBUS_BUS_ADDR:?}`;處理中 | HW-00049~00056 |

> 註:Q-LIT 29 條為**真缺陷**(內層未跳脫雙引號),非 escaped 合法型;沿用 Round-1 已拍板修法(內層單引號)。
> 假完成 8 條 = operator 已拍板採 **B**:標 PARTIAL + 補真 `i2cget <reg>` + `${PMBUS_BUS_ADDR:?}`。

### 232/2291 — `Wistron-HW-00242-V003` · Items=No TPM with bitlocker · TestSet=Function Check
- **ai_can_execute(現行)** = `NO` | **verdict(§二十一)= NO** | exec 模式 = `物理(agent 不跑)`

**8 問**:
- Q1 測什麼:No TPM with bitlocker
- Q2 位置:物理/目視(agent 不跑)
- Q3 機台:待 operator 圈定實際 SUT(L2 才跑)
- Q4 時機:單次
- Q5 看什麼:1. Enable BitLocker Without TPM
First, you need to configure your Windows policy to allow BitLocker without a TPM.

Using Group Policy Editor
Open the Group Policy Editor:

Press Win + R, type gpedit.msc, and press Enter.
Navigate to the BitLocker Policy:

Go to Computer Configuration > Administrative Templates > Windows Components > BitLocker Drive Encryption > Operating System Drives.
Configure Policy:

Find the policy Require additional authentication at startup and double-click to edit it.
Enable the policy.
Ensure the option Allow BitLocker without a compatible TPM (requires a password or a startup key on a USB flash drive) is checked.
Click Apply and OK.
2. Enable BitLocker on a Drive
Once the policy is set, you can proceed to enable BitLocker.

Using BitLocker GUI
Open File Explorer:

Right-click on the drive you want to encrypt (e.g., C: drive).
Select Turn on BitLocker.
Choose Authentication Method:

Select Enter a password or Insert a USB flash drive.
Follow the prompts to set a password or use a USB flash drive.
Save Recovery Key:

Save the recovery key to a file, print it, or store it somewhere safe.
Encrypt the Drive:

Choose the type of encryption (New or Compatible mode).
Start the encryption process.
Using Command Line
You can also use the manage-bde command-line tool to enable BitLocker.

Open Command Prompt as Administrator:

Press Win + X, then select Command Prompt (Admin) or Windows PowerShell (Admin).
Enable BitLocker with a Password:

manage-bde -on C: -password
Follow Prompts:

Enter and confirm the password when prompted.
Save Recovery Key:

manage-bde -protectors -add C: -rp
3. Check BitLocker Status
To verify that BitLocker is enabled and working without a TPM, check the status.

GUI Method
Open BitLocker Drive Encryption:
Go to Control Panel > System and Security > BitLocker Drive Encryption.
Ensure that the drive is listed as BitLocker On.
Command Line Method
Open Command Prompt as Administrator.
Check Status:
manage-bde -status C:
This command will show the status of BitLocker on the specified drive, including the encryption method and the protectors used.
- Q6 補什麼:none
- Q7 回報:R36(agent 陳述事實,operator 判)
- Q8 邊界:見 🚧

## 批次說明(第 401–600 條組成)

| 區段 | 約 row | 類型 | 主判定 |
|---|---|---|---|
| BIOS Save/Exit 頁(00069~00071)| 403–405 | BIOS setup 畫面導航 | NO |
| ADVANCE/Change BIOS 全家族(00072~00140)| 405–473 | BIOS setup 畫面改動+reboot | NO |
| Chipset/PCIe Compliance(00125)| 458 | BIOS setup 前置 | NO |
| NUMA/efibootmgr/SSD-FW(00141~00143)| 474–476 | OS 只讀驗證(前置 NPS/BIOS side) | PARTIAL |
| PSP(00144)| 477 | workbook TBD | UNRESOLVED |
| PLDM save/restore、UEFI Shell(00145~00148)| 478–481 | BIOS/PLDM/UEFI-Shell 前置 | NO |
| SMBIOS Type 0~16(00149~00269)| 482–602 | dmidecode 全量只讀 | YES |

## 第 401–600 條 review 統計

**verdict(§二十一 鎖版)分布(本批 200 條)**:
| verdict | 條數 | 說明 |
|---|---|---|
| NO/PHYSICAL | 74 | BIOS setup 畫面導航/改動(ADVANCE/Change BIOS 各頁、Save&Exit、PLDM save-restore、UEFI Shell)、Chipset 前置 |
| PARTIAL | 3 | NUMA 驗證(NPS 需 operator 前置)、efibootmgr(改 nvram 後要還原)、SSD FW(BIOS-side 讀需 operator) |
| YES | 122 | SMBIOS Type 0~16 全量 dmidecode 只讀 + SMBIOS version 讀 |
| UNRESOLVED | 1 | BIOS-00144 PSP(Procedure/Criteria 在 workbook 即 TBD) |

**瑕疵統計(四類必抓 + Q-LIT/E-DQ)**:
| class | 條數 | 對應編號 |
|---|---|---|
| Q-LIT(ssh 內層 grep 雙引號→單引號) | 3 | BIOS-00141、00143、00147 |
| E-DQ(ssh 內層 echo 雙引號→單引號) | 1 | BIOS-00141(與 Q-LIT 同批修) |
| DBL-SSH(遠端內再包 sshpass/ssh) | 0 | efibootmgr 為「順序兩次單層 ssh」,非嵌套,不算 |
| R5(OOB ipmitool lanplus 誤包 DUT-ssh) | 0 | 本批無 OOB ipmitool 題 |
| §十九 o 假完成(fio --version 等) | 0 | 本批無「跑測試」題 |
| §十八 b(vendor slot 未標) | 未另列 | NUMA NPS 前置 / efibootmgr nvram 還原 / SSD BIOS-side 讀均標 PARTIAL+前置 |

> 註:本批為「BIOS setup 畫面導航 + SMBIOS 全量只讀」二大塊。**Q-LIT 3 條(BIO-141/143/147)為真 parse 缺陷**,
> 沿用 Round-1 已拍板修法(內層單引號)已實際修進 xlsx(rows 474/476/480);E-DQ 與 Q-LIT 同批(474)。
> SMBIOS 120 條 dmidecode 均用正確 escaped `\"` 形式(非 Q-LIT),全量 `-t N` 只讀 + 粗篩指定欄位(§十九 p),
> 不 grep 挑行漏抓 → 合格。
> **BIOS-00144(PSP)= UNRESOLVED**:Procedure 與 Criteria 在 workbook 原始檔即 TBD(無測試步驟/無預期結果),
> 依 §二十一「資料 TBD → UNRESOLVED」判;需 operator 依 vendor 補 PSP firmware-version 檢查步驟才可進 PARTIAL/YES。
> 判定(ai_can_execute)本批**全未改**,只修 `ai_commands` 內文(3 條)。

**🔄 累計(第 1–600 條)**:
| verdict | 條數 |
|---|---|
| NO/PHYSICAL | 234 |
| PARTIAL | 172 |
| YES | 193 |
| UNRESOLVED | 1 |
| 合計 | 600 |

### 1975/2291 — `Wistron-AMD SVM-00039-V003` · Items=Bad Page Persistent · TestSet=RAS
- **ai_can_execute(現行)** = `PARTIAL` | **verdict(§二十一)= PARTIAL** | exec 模式 = `有前置(需 operator 給變數/在場)`

- Q4 時機:單次
- Q5 看什麼:• PASS = 
- AMDGPURAS tool GFX error injection command returns Bus error.
- Redfish command for CPER index retrieval shows the CPER index is increased and new CPER file is generated upon the error injected.
- The decoded result from the decoded CPER log matches the injected error type and location.
• Error location lists the OAM on which the error occurred.
• Bank matches the type of error injected: UMC.
• Errorcode ext is 0 and Errocode ext Type is On-die ECC.
• Error severity matches the type of error injected: Deferred error.
• Bank matches the type of error injected: GC.
• Errorcode ext is 62 and Errocode ext Type is GfxGcError.
• Error severity matches the type of error injected: Uncorrected Error. Poison
has been consumed.
- The list of retired bad page addresses remains the same as the list prior to AC cycle.
- The inband CPER log matches the OAM devices and error severity level
- Q6 補什麼:AMDGPU-RAS tool (amdgpuras) + Redfish CPER access
- Q7 回報:R36(agent 陳述事實,operator 判)

- ▶ 指令(現行)

  log 取位:return the injection result + CPER index + persistent page record so the user confirms the bad page is retained across power cycles.

- Q4 時機:單次
- Q5 看什麼:When completed, the diagnostic will return 0 to the shell if completed
normally. If an error occurs, it will return 1 to the shell, and if a retest is
required it will return 2. It will also print “PASS”, “FAIL”, or “RETEST” to
the screen.
PASS – The hardware passes the diagnostics
FAIL – The hardware has failed the diagnostics
RETEST – The hardware setup has failed the pre-check portion of the
diagnostics and a warning message appears describing the problem.
Correct the problem per the pre-check message and then test again.
